vision.name: Gotenks' Galactic Donut
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(If this card is destroyed or banished from your Life Deck, gain 3 stages and Rejuvenate it.)
[Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
Raise your anger 1 level.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Attach to your opponent's MP. While attached, at the beginning of your turn, you may Rejuvenate this card to banish the top 2 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.
